Cascade Funding
Open Calls
Cascade funding to empower knowledge valorisation intermediaries to adopt, test and scale the ERA Guiding Principles and Codes of Practice
VALLEYS offers two competitive open calls to fund knowledge valorisation intermediaries across Europe. Choose the call that matches your organisation's readiness and ambition.
Coming in 2027
Open Call #2
Knowledge Valorisation Intermediaries
Expected: 2027
Deadline: TBC
Up to €40,000 per funded action
A second round of cascade funding. Details and timeline will be published as the project progresses.
Preview details →

Competitive funding for organisations to test and implement innovative approaches to knowledge valorisation aligned with EU Codes of Practice.
